glomeris check-project-root — Is this a project root, or does it hold several?

usage: glomeris check-project-root <path> [--json]

Read-only — changes nothing.

Reads `path` and its immediate children only — never a subprocess, never a
recursive walk below that one level (HORO-1629) — and reports whether it
looks like a project root itself, a folder holding several projects one level
down, a folder with no project markers at all, or that the bounded read could
not be completed. Meant to run BEFORE a folder is added as a `--project-root`,
because `cargo_target_dir`/`node_modules`/ `swiftpm_build_dir` only ever look
one level below a configured root: adding a folder that holds many projects
(e.g. `~/code`) yields a clean bill of health with nothing examined below it,
and this is the check that catches that before it happens.

Options
  --json
      Print a CheckProjectRootReport as JSON on stdout.

Examples
  glomeris check-project-root ~/code --json
      Is ~/code itself a project, or does it hold several?

See also: detect
